On dry, mixed terrain, the Martello Enduro Race provides surgical control.

mezcal-xc-race.tagline: The new Mezcal XC Race; A never-ending success in a new size. The Mezcal XC Race is built using the new XC Race Formulation and have been torture tested at the UCI elite levels. The Race Formulation employs Graphene and Silica, providing increased wet grip and suppleness, and combines a 60TPI tubeless ready casing to optimize deformation. This combination has been shown to reduce rider fatigue while simultaneously increasing race-day reliability.
mezcal-xc-race.summary: The continuous center line maintains fast-rolling contact, and its offset extensions are siped to multiply the number of leading and trailing edges, propelling you up the trail on climbs and increasing bite while braking. The rear siping on the shoulder knobs runs parallel to the trail with variable widths and open trailing edges, so the Mezcal corners fast on hard, slippery surfaces – despite being such a fast-rolling tire. For climbing, cornering, or careening down hill, no tire cooks like the Mezcal.

The familiar Vittoria v-formation used in the Peyote allows the tire to dig through loose terrain to find traction while evacuating debris laterally.

Awarded at the Taipei Cycle Show 2024, this tire represents the new era of cycling.

terreno-t10-hardpack-gravel-endurance.tagline: The Terreno T10 Hardpack Gravel Endurance tire is the most road-efficient model in the Vittoria Gravel Endurance range, engineered for speed and control on compact surfaces.  The heart of the T10 is Vittoria’s Endurance Formulation powered by Graphene, delivering proven durability, weather resistance, and consistent performance across seasons and surfaces. A Corsa-inspired and fast rolling slick center strip is paired with revolutionary fish scale shoulders, adapted from the Terreno T30, for added cornering grip and navigating wet or variable terrain. Built with our Endurance Casing, the T10 offers high adaptability and structural strength for long-distance riding, reinforced with a nylon sidewall protection layer and an anti-puncture belt to ensure maximum reliability and peace of mind.
terreno-t10-hardpack-gravel-endurance.summary: From tarmac to fast rolling hardpack, the T10 brings road-like efficiency to the gravel world—with the endurance pedigree to match.

Built from the Endurance Formulation powered by Graphene, the T70 tread offers weather-resistant dependability, all-condition performance, and the long-lasting resilience needed for epic gravel outings. A fast-rolling center tread ensures momentum on straights, while aggressive shoulder knobs and full-depth tread siping bring control and confidence in corners, offering exceptional traction when terrain gets technical.

Electrically cured to eliminate seams and increase aerodynamics. The Corsa Pro Tube Type provides an impossibly supple connection to the road, erasing rolling resistance, denying road debris, and inspiring confidence through sweeping corners.

corsa-pro-tube-type.tagline: Ultimate cornering grip in wet or dry conditions. Reinforced puncture resistance. A supple construction that reduces rolling resistance and makes chattery chip seal feel like freshly laid tarmac. The Corsa PRO combines the convenience of a tube-type clincher platform with the pedigree of the world’s most successful racing tire, proven in the rarefied air of France’s highest passes and the punchy finales of the classics alike.
corsa-pro-tube-type.summary: The new Corsa PRO Tube-type y delivers a 12% improvement in rolling efficiency, 18% extra puncture resistance, and a 9% weight reduction compared to its predecessor, Corsa Tube-type.

corsa-pro-tubular.tech_intro: The revolutionary grip and durability of Graphene + Silica compounds. The timeless perfection of a 320 TPI cotton casing. The inimitable ride quality of a latex innertube. The Corsa PRO Tubular creates an impossibly supple connection to the road, erasing rolling resistance, denying road debris, and inspiring confidence through sweeping corners. It even boosts aerodynamics with its seamless, electrical curing.

features.title: Race Formulation Graphene + Silica
features.text: The Race Formulation powered by Graphene + Silica is a high-performance compound mix developed for pro-level racing. It delivers an optimal balance of speed and grip, offering maximum efficiency in straight-line performance with confident handling in corners.

features.title: 320 TPI Cotton-corespun casing
features.text: Lightweight cotton and durable aramid, spun in a 320 TPI casing that combines the former’s intuitive, supple road feel with the latter’s puncture resistance.

features.title: Anti-Puncture Belt
features.text: Designed to provide extra puncture resistance, ensuring your ride stays smooth and uninterrupted.

corsa-pro-tubular.tagline: No tire responds like a tubular, and no tubular feels like the Corsa PRO. High cornering grip in wet or dry conditions, low rolling resistance, and an impossibly supple conformity that smooths rough roads and connects you intuitively to the tarmac – The tubular Corsa PRO is the ultimate racing tire. It’s also extremely light: each pair is 190g lighter than tubeless-ready Corsa PRO tires run with sealant or with latex tubes.
corsa-pro-tubular.summary: With material technology proven in the WorldTour peloton – from the punchiest monuments to the most punishing grand tours – and incomparable weight savings, the Corsa PRO Tubular is the world’s fastest tire for pure speed.

juniores-tubular.tech_intro: The Juniores’ cotton casing preserves the supple road feel that only a tubular can provide while maintaining an entry-level price point. It’s mated to a compound that privileges longevity, durability, and puncture resistance over outright speed – ideal qualities for a young riders taking to their first start lines.

features.title: 1C compound
features.text: A revolutionary compound engineered with Graphene for high grip, minimal rolling resistance, and low weight. Simple, supple, superlative, and ideal for the velodrome.

features.title: 220 TPI Cotton casing
features.text: Cotton provides an inimitable connection to the road. Compared to synthetic casing, cotton is smoother, more supple, and lower weight – the foundational truth behind the legendary ride quality of tubular tires.

juniores-tubular.tagline: Coppi apocryphally said that age and treachery will defeat youth and skill, but with the Juniores Tubular, youth and skill may have a chance. The Juniores introduces the next generation of champions to the time-tested technology ridden by every previous generation’s heroes: the tubular tire.
juniores-tubular.summary: The Juniores’ construction is similar to the Rally, just sized down for smaller wheels. Its buttery-smooth ride helps neo-pros – who are just learning to read a race – also learn to feel the road in a way traditional clinchers and tubeless tires simply can’t.

sidewall-cleaner.tech_intro: Vittoria Sidewall Cleaner is a high-performance solution designed to effortlessly clean and restore the appearance of your bicycle tire sidewalls.
sidewall-cleaner.tagline: Its powerful yet gentle formula ensures that your tires look pristine without compromising their structure, making it an essential addition to any cyclist's maintenance routine.
sidewall-cleaner.summary: This is the only product available in the market that can be used for cotton tires, bringing them back to shine with their original beauty. The application sponge makes the cleaning operation super easy and quick.

standard-butyl-inner-tube.tech_intro: High air retention, easy mounting, reliable puncture resistance, and a 0.9mm tube wall – butyl inner tubes define the reliable convenience of clinchers.
standard-butyl-inner-tube.tagline: The classic tube for all applications
standard-butyl-inner-tube.summary: When you ride daily, reliability means everything, and no inner tube handles the grind like butyl. It retains air across multiple days and its more rugged qualities mean it can be tossed around in a jersey pocket or saddlebag and installed on the side of the road or trail when needed.

tubeless-rim-tape-new.tech_intro: Vittoria Tubeless Rim Tape is a key component for any tubeless application.
tubeless-rim-tape-new.tagline: Vittoria Tubeless Rim Tape is a key component for any tubeless application.
tubeless-rim-tape-new.summary: Designed to save weight and ensure an airtight seal, Vittoria Tubeless Rim Tape prevents air from leaking through the rim and facilitates the installation of tubeless tires.

zaffiro-evo.tagline: It provides the confidence and proven performance you need to keep going, ride after ride. As a durable road bike tire designed for everyday use, it combines reliability, puncture resistance, and consistent performance in all conditions. Zaffiro Evo is inspired by WorldTour-proven technology, adapting race-derived performance to real-world roads. Take on rough chip seal, potholes, and unpredictable weather with ease.
zaffiro-evo.summary: Whether you're logging base miles or commuting through changing conditions, Zaffiro EVO transforms daily road challenges into smooth, controlled performance. A reliable road bike tire built to last, it proves its value every time the road gets tough.
